name: oanarina-archi-tool
description: Oanarina Archi Tool for Windows: Electron shell around the archi-engine (ArchiCore).
author: Oana Rinaldi

scripts.build: node tools/gen-ui-data.mjs && node tools/gen-l10n.mjs && node build.mjs
scripts.test:ui: node tools/gen-ui-data.mjs && node build.mjs --web && node test/ui-snapshots.mjs
scripts.test:menus: node tools/gen-ui-data.mjs && node build.mjs --web && node test/menus-keys.mjs
scripts.test:win: node tools/gen-ui-data.mjs && node build.mjs --web && node test/windows-conventions.mjs && node packaging/smoke-electron.mjs --web test-results/smoke-web
scripts.dist: node packaging/sync-version.mjs && npm run build && python packaging/make-ico.py .. packaging/build/icon.ico && electron-builder --win --x64 --config packaging/electron-builder.yml --publish never
